test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'to'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here the word **'stomach'** is used as a verb.
 
• **Stomach** as a verb means to bear without overt reaction or resentment.
 
 
• Example- She couldn't **stomach** the ongoing office politics.
 
 
 
• There is already a verb present in the same sentence (**find**), so there is a need for a **to-infinitive** to include the other verb in the sentence.
 
• Among the given options, 'to' is the most appropriate one because it makes the verb a to-infinitive form.
